input.detail:
## Task Complete — Build how-to-play modal component with game instructions

**Commit:** `673c46a` on `feature/sv-0317`

### Files changed (4):

1. **`app/components/HowToPlayModal.tsx`** (new) — Full modal component with:
   - 5 instruction steps covering: straight/curve tiles, rotation, path connection, Go button, par/clover scoring
   - `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing to heading
   - Focus trapped via Tab/Shift+Tab cycling within the panel
   - Focus saved on mount and restored to triggering element on unmount
   - Close button (✕) and backdrop click both call `onClose`
   - Escape handled by parent `useHelpShortcut` hook
   - Fixed overlay (does not unmount/reset canvas)
   - Consistent Tailwind styling matching LevelComplete pattern
   - `INSTRUCTIONS` data and `FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR` exported for pure testing

2. **`app/components/HowToPlayModal.test.ts`** (new) — 18 pure-data tests:
   - Content coverage: verifies all 7 required mechanics are mentioned
   - Structure: validates icon/title/body shape, non-empty values, frozen immutability
   - FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR: validates all interactive element types included, disabled exclusions

3. **`app/components/index.ts`** — Added `HowToPlayModal` to barrel exports

4. **`app/routes/play.tsx`** — Replaced 25-line inline modal with `<HowToPlayModal onClose={toggleHowToPlay} />`; updated import budget comment

### Test results: 180 passed (10 files), 0 failed
### Lint: clean (0 errors, 0 warnings)

### Acceptance criteria met:
- ✅ Modal renders overlay above game board without unmounting canvas
- ✅ Content covers tile types, rotation, path goal, Go button, par/clover scoring
- ✅ Close button and Escape key both dismiss
- ✅ Focus trapped inside modal, restored to trigger on close
- ✅ role="dialog" with aria-labelledby
- ✅ Visually consistent with existing game UI (Tailwind, emerald palette, same animations)
